card.summary: 2 GB of cloud, 1 GB of mail and 500 MB of CryptPad, free. Extra space is sold in annual steps: 5 GB EUR 11/year, 10 GB EUR 20, 15 GB EUR 29, 30 GB EUR 56, 45...

free_tier.stated: 2 GB of cloud, 1 GB of mail and 500 MB of CryptPad, free. Extra space is sold in annual steps: 5 GB EUR 11/year, 10 GB EUR 20, 15 GB EUR 29, 30 GB EUR 56, 45 GB EUR 83, 60 GB EUR 110, with 21% VAT added for EU residents

retention.stated: Until deleted. No retention clock published

egress.terms: No published cap. The instance is donation-funded and the guidance asks users not to overuse it; that is a fair-use sentence and not a number

record.tooling: rclone webdav and the Nextcloud clients, which is the one real advantage: it needs no wrapper
record.chaining: Nothing to chain. The absolute ceiling is 60 GB at any price, so it cannot hold a share of a 10 TiB working set and cannot participate in a pool. Its role would be as a small always-available mount for a bridge's state

limits.value: extra capacity is granted by a human-reviewed application form, not by a self-serve checkout

identity_cost.detail: a Disroot account. The extra-storage form is a separate human review that asks why the space is needed

record.reliability_note: Donation-funded and rate-conscious. Extra storage is reviewed by hand, so capacity is a request and not a purchase. Ordering is by annual invoice with VAT added for EU residents. The operator's status page reports that the Nextcloud Files feature is disabled after a hardware failure on the storage server while calendars, contacts and chat work, and its 2026-11-02 update says some unreadable disk regions may lead to unrecoverable data

evidence.proved: 'If the free 2GB is not enough, you can extend your cloud storage', with WebDAV and the Nextcloud clients listed as access paths
'FREE storage: 1GB for your emails, 2GB for the cloud, 500MB for cryptpad'; tiers '5GB for 11 EUR annually' up to '60GB for 110 EUR annually'; 'European users have to add a VAT of 21%'
the status page states the Nextcloud Files feature is disabled until a storage failure is solved while calendars, contacts and chat work
evidence.quote: Nextcloud - Files feature has been disabled until the issue is solved, calendars, contacts, chat etc works as normal

evidence.proved: the 2026-11-02 status update says unreadable disk regions may lead to unrecoverable data
evidence.quote: some unreadable region does exist on the disk which may lead to unrecoverable data

evidence.proved: the site root serves a maintenance page headed Major hardware failure on storage server
the Nextcloud service page answers HTTP 404 while the site root serves the maintenance page
the status page states the Nextcloud Files feature is disabled
evidence.quote: Nextcloud - Files feature has been disabled until the issue is solved, calendars, contacts, chat etc works as normal

record.price_per_tb_month: EUR 110/year for 60 GB, which is EUR 152/TB/year and therefore irrelevant
record.binding_note: The quota closes it at 60 GB, but the gate that matters more is that capacity above 2 GB is a human decision rather than a purchase, so no plan can be built on a number that arrives by review.
record.confidence_note: Confidence is reported: documentation is dated to research on 2026-10-21. Raising confidence to documented or measured requires re-reading the storage expansion form and executing live WebDAV PROPFIND requests against an active account.
